instruction: I need to export the presentation as a GIF image. Please save it as res.gif on the Desktop using default export options.

metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting LibreOffice Impress presentation to GIF format. The evaluator checks if the output file res.gif exists on the Desktop. Custom getter get_file_exists__25309a67d723dd8e75eb60c978b60929 checks file existence via bash command, and metric check_file_exists__25309a67d723dd8e75eb60c978b60929 validates that the file was created.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator checks all three critical requirements - file existence, valid GIF format via MIME type verification, and non-zero file size
Correct semantic logic: Getter extracts file state using appropriate bash commands (file existence check, MIME type via 'file -b --mime-type', size check via '[ -s ]')
Proper false positive prevention: Metric requires ALL conditions to be true (exists AND is_gif AND has_content), preventing false positives from empty files or wrong format files
Correct data flow: Getter returns structured dict with 'exists', 'is_gif', 'has_content' keys; metric correctly validates all three aspects against expected rules
Runtime feasibility: All bash commands used are standard and will execute correctly on the VM
